title: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Assn. v. Union of India (NJAC)

content.caseIdentity: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Assn. v. Union of India (NJAC), (2016) 5 SCC 1
content.holding: The 99th Constitutional Amendment (NJAC) struck down; independence of the judiciary is an essential feature of Basic Structure.
content.relevance: Modern application invalidating a judicial appointments amendment.
